reason: The patch correctly addresses a limitation in the BrentSolver where the solver would throw an IllegalArgumentException if the function values at the endpoints did not have opposite signs, even if one of the endpoints was already a root (within the specified accuracy). By checking if either endpoint is a root before throwing the exception, the solver becomes more robust and consistent with the behavior of the solve(min, max, initial) method.
